notesForDownstream: Logger times only: every time is on the logger clock mapped to the GPS lap-t base (7/30 per-lap channel shift). The video <-> logger offset is NOT addressed here.
Kerb contacts: detection = published RR detector (reproduced 44/44) + VA clusters; onset refined on 4 Hz HP / 0.06 s RMS. Refined onset - published t0: median -0.082 s (IQR -0.237..0.038).

Onset estimator on synthetic bursts in real noise (verify_contact_onset_bias.json): about -10..-35 ms (early) at burst/baseline ratio 16-32, about +/-15 ms at 8, late by +20..+140 ms at 4 (RR mostly undetected at 4).
7/29 (wet) has only 4 inside passes with a contact (2 high, 2 VA-only low): kerb-event truth for 7/29 is thin; steering / yaw / clip markers exist for all passes.
k15 and k23 contacts happen while the car still steers the other way (track-out of k1 / k10): at that moment they act as outside kerbs (flag steeringAwayFromKerbSide...).
Merged corner sequences (shared steering / yaw onset): k19 with k18 (300R), and on some laps k10 with k9, k21 with k20, k24 with k23 (flags sharesSteerOnsetWith / sharesYawOnsetWith).
Telemetry clipping markers {minSpeed, latGPeak, yawRatePeak, steerMax} spread per pass: median 0.662 s (7/29) / 0.936 s (7/30); the clipping point is not one instant.
7/30 kerb-contact onset vs yaw-rate peak: median 0.027 s, vs steer max -0.064 s, vs min speed -0.625 s (positive = marker later than the contact onset).
Steering onset -> yaw onset: 0.169 s (7/29) vs 0.09 s (7/30). Both channels get the same shift on 7/30, so the difference is logger-internal (wet/dry response or ECU/IMU latency; not resolved).

Corner speed minimum: GPS Speed (-0.09 s) minus rear wheels = 0.017 s (7/29) / 0.013 s (7/30), interior minima: consistent with the 7/30 shift and the 0.09 s Doppler lag (derived cross-check, not a proof). ECU_VEH_SPD minimum is earlier by -0.155 s.
